about: Brandon is in southwestern Manitoba, on the Assiniboine River west of Winnipeg. It is the province’s second-largest city, a service and agriculture centre for the Wheat City hinterland, with the Keystone Centre as a major indoor exhibition venue. A compact downtown sits above the river flats. About 51,000 people live in Brandon.
